provenance.harness: an independently written cross-verification driver that constructs the type-11 key exactly as SigUtil.cvtToJavaEdDSAKey does and delegates every operation to the unmodified upstream engine
provenance.build: javac over the pinned core/java/src/net/i2p/crypto/eddsa subtree, compiled unmodified; the harness supplies only net.i2p.util.RandomSource and net.i2p.data.DataHelper, the two trivial helpers the subtree calls
provenance.independence: the reference sources are compiled unmodified; no Java I2P source is copied into i2pr
provenance.license: reference output only; no Java I2P source or class file is redistributed as code
provenance.no_private_key_recorded: the blinded private scalar is deliberately absent. Java signs with a random 80-byte Zcash nonce, so a committed private key could not reproduce this signature anyway; the three facts these rows need are the blinded public key, the signed message, and the signature.
provenance.shares_material_with: red25519-i2pd-differential.json case 0: the same blinded scalar, the same blinded public key, and the same signed message. Only the signature differs, so the two fixtures isolate the transcript and nothing else.
